Tasche in der Planfläche aus den geschlo: Pocket in the face from the closed contours of a sketch (inner contours remain as islands), with a live flat end mill along Z. Auf der Kurve (Nutbreite = Fräser-Ø): On the curve (slot width = cutter Ø)
Kurven einer Skizze, die längs zur Dreha: Curves of a sketch lying along the rotary axis are wrapped onto the circumference and milled with a live cutter pointing at the axis (Z and C move together; Fanuc: cylindrical interpolation G7.1). The sketch plane defines the angle at which the contour sits; horizontal lines in the sketch become arcs around the part. Depth from the outer diameter.
Kurven einer Skizze auf der Planfläche (: Curves of a sketch on the face (across the rotary axis) with a live cutter along Z (X and C move together; Fanuc: polar interpolation G12.1). Open curves are milled back and forth. Depth from the face.
Nut längs der Drehachse (z. B. Passfeder: Slot along the rotary axis (e.g. keyway) with a live cutter pointing at the axis; the main spindle holds the part as C axis. Slot width = cutter Ø. Start/end Z in model Z; if the slot reaches the face, the cutter enters from the front, otherwise it plunges at the start. Depth from the outer diameter.
Flächen am Teilende (Zweiflach, Vierkant: Flats at the end of the part (two flats, square, hexagon) with a live flat end mill along Z. Width across flats = twice the distance of the flat from the rotary axis. X and C move together (polar interpolation, Fanuc G12.1); without this template in the post processor, short X/C steps are output.
Schruppt die Bohrung von der Vorbohrung: Roughs the bore from the pre-drilled hole outwards (0,2 mm finishing allowance), then finishes it down to the bottom. The boring bar must fit into the pre-drilled hole.
Schruppt simultan 4-achsig von außen nac: Roughs in simultaneous 4-axis from the outside in: one spiral around the A axis per stepdown (alternating in +X and −X), never deeper than the part plus stock to leave. With flat or ball end mill.
Wickelt die Skizzenkurven auf den Zylind: Wraps the sketch curves onto the cylinder: X stays X, the distance across the axis becomes an arc on the wrapping Ø (rotation A). The sketch must be parallel to the A axis, e.g. on a tangent plane. Milling runs at a fixed depth below the part surface – for engravings, lettering and slots around the part.
Simultan 4-achsig: Drehachse A entlang X: Simultaneous 4-axis: rotary axis A along X through the stock center (cylindrical stock: its axis). The ball end mill stands radial to the axis, A rotates the part. Set the work origin Y/Z on the axis; after machining, A moves to a multiple of 360°.
